mainEntity.name: Who benefits most from home injection services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elderly patients, people with mobility issues, patients on long-term therapy, post-surgery recovery patients, and parents who want easier care for their kids.

mainEntity.name: What safety measures should a nurse follow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Licensed nurse only, use sterile needles and gloves, doctor-approved medications, check allergy history, and follow correct injection technique.

mainEntity.name: What types of injections are provided at home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic injections, complex injections, antibiotic shots, pain-relief injections, vitamin shots, immunity boosters, anti-allergy injections, and IV drip therapy if prescribed.

mainEntity.name: How much do home injection services cost in Tashkent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic injection: 25,000–40,000 UZS, Complex injection: 40,000–60,000 UZS, Nurse home visit: 20,000–50,000 UZS, IV drip: 60,000–120,000 UZS.

mainEntity.name: Why do some nurses make injections nearly painless?

acceptedAnswer.text: They combine sharp observation, precise technique, correct angle, smooth motion, and patient calming, making vein access easy and comfortable.
